title: Ingo Swann's book Penetration says the moon is a hollow spaceship
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ingo Swann's book Penetration says the moon is a hollow spaceship, about Stargate era at The Moon, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he wrote a book called Penetration. And uh he was part of the CIA psychic spy program called Stargate.
he wrote a book called Penetration where he talks about uh remote viewing the dark side of the moon.
tellings.difference: Describes the book as remote viewing the far side of the Moon, not the Moon as a hollow spaceship, and credits Axelrod.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Ingo Swann's book Penetration and what it says about the Moon.

as_told.title: Ingo Swann's Penetration: Axelrod and an alien base on the Moon's far side
as_told.place_text: Underground location; dark side of the Moon

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a psychic named Ingo Swann, who he says was part of Stargate, a CIA program that tried to use psychics as spies, and who wrote a book called Penetration. In one episode Michels ties the book to the idea that the Moon is a hollow spaceship, while in another he says it is about remote viewing, trying to see distant places with the mind, the dark side of the Moon, and links it to a man named Axelrod. If true, it would mean someone or something is active on the Moon, out of sight.
